parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Urban raccoons live in towns. Although they are nocturnal their large size means they may be noticed by humans. They may be found raiding bins containing food waste, or entering buildings.

Describe a method for estimating the size of a raccoon population in a town.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Raccoons are classified in the phylum Chordata of the kingdom Animalia.

Name the domain to which raccoons belong.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Outline three characteristic features of members of this domain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
It has been suggested that raccoons may threaten biodiversity and pose a risk to human health in Germany.

Explain how raccoons could cause problems for local biodiversity **and** for human health.
